description: Where a request_booking request stands. A home cleaning reference (hmr_): waiting for the customer on WhatsApp, declined, expired, awaiting payment (with the payment link), finding a cleaning expert, booked (with the next visit), done or cancelled; for changes, the customer messages Helen on WhatsApp. A call-back reference (hmc_): booked with its window, called, or closed; to move it, call request_booking again with a new window. Never includes the customer's details.

reference.description: The reference request_booking returned (starts with hmr_ or hmc_).
